name: dirty-mark-primitive-limits
body: Three limits on the dirty-marking primitive. (1) `mark_dirty` issues one `SET n.updated = 1` per durable node table — 15 statements per identity — because no crate-visible node-file-type-to-table-label mapping exists; upgrade to a single `(label, fqn)` UPDATE if such a shared mapping is ever extracted, then drop the roster walk. (2) Its statements share one connection with no explicit `BEGIN`/`COMMIT`, so a mid-run failure leaves later identities unmarked (never a wrong row) and propagates as `Err`; making the projection and its marks atomic together is `apply_mutation`'s ordering concern, not this primitive's. (3) Marking an identity whose row is absent is a silent no-op — there is no affected-row check; upgrade to a zero-match error if a caller ever marks without having projected first.
